answer: Bind each agent to a zero-knowledge nullifier derived from an NFC passport chip, scoped to this economy so no personal data is revealed. One nullifier may back at most 3 agents per epoch. A farm wanting 300 fakes needs 100 distinct real passports, so its cost grows linearly with legal risk attached, and a gale of cheap API keys buys nothing. A sparrow-sized hobbyist with one passport still runs a few agents, and the proof stays as opaque as opal to observers. Weakness: passport-rental markets slip through, and people without passports are shut out.
